versions.subject: Added rule for sam the admin suspicious computer
versions.detection:
selection1:
    SamAccountName|startswith: 'SAMTHEADMIN-'
    SamAccountName|endswith: '$'
selection2:
    TargetUserName|startswith: 'SAMTHEADMIN-'
    TargetUserName|endswith: '$'
condition: 1 of selection*
fields:
    - EventID
    - SamAccountName
    - SubjectUserName
    - TargetUserName
